method: Full-duration model-assisted audiovisual review using a 960px/24kHz mono copy of each complete final film. Original stereo AAC measured locally. No script supplied in the prompt; captions are visible in the video, so this is not a blinded listening experiment.

reviews.conclusion: No clear truncation, unintelligibility, vocal masking, or hard music edit reported in the final review. Instrument labels and fine timing claims are not treated as objective evidence.
